title: Current expansion hold binding surface
description: Objective: remove the cyclic/test-only authority gap between an ACTIVE durable hold and the EXPANSION PlanningRun that must be opened before scheduler admission. Deliverable: extract and publish a direction-safe scheduler root function `bindCurrentExpansionHold` that accepts only a reducer-produced hold plus daemon-current goal/epoch/hold/run counters, replays and exact-compares the hold, and returns the validated core PlanningExpansionHoldBinding; refactor bindExpansionAdmission to compose that one producer. Also preserve the planning inspector's exact refusal target in bridge issues. Consumers: the atomic expansion-request task and task-c4171c1cfe854cb78dd233794b342025. NOT in scope: persistence, scheduler admission, approval, or child/graph authority. Owned paths: focused packages/scheduler/src/expansion current-hold module/bridge/test plus curated root surface tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Public `bindCurrentExpansionHold(value)` exact-parses `{currentAuthority,hold}`, requires all five current values, replays the creation receipt through `reduceExpansionPlanningHold`, exact-compares the presented ACTIVE v1 state, verifies goalVersion/graphEpoch/holdId/holdVersion/planningRunRef, and returns one deeply frozen core-valid `PlanningExpansionHoldBinding` or typed UNKNOWN/REFUSED.

`bindExpansionAdmission` calls the new production function rather than retaining a second hold/current mapper; unchanged successful inputs produce byte-identical planning/admitted bindings and unchanged refusal precedence/codes/layers/origins.

Every bridge issue carries exact nullable `target`; delegated `inspectPlanningExpansionContract` refusals preserve its target such as `HOLD_BINDING`, while local/hold/fairness issues use null and never invent provenance.
The curated bare `@moe/scheduler` root exports the runtime function and complete type closure with an exact LF bridge; consumers need no deep import.

Focused tests pin every current-authority mismatch and delegated origin/code/layer/target, exact success bytes, nonzero hostile cases, and mutation drills for hold replay, each current comparison, and target propagation.
taskRails: This is the sole production hold-to-PlanningRun binding producer; daemon and tests must not rebuild the projection or set DAEMON_VERIFIED themselves.
Do not reorder or weaken bindExpansionAdmission's preparation/fairness/admission gates, and do not add persistence or activation.
Use public @moe/core root imports, exact code/layer/origin/target assertions and positive generated counts; target <=250 lines per production source and split before 400.

Perform the final adversarial review over the owned-path merge-base diff: attack hostile descriptors/proxies, replay laundering, UNKNOWN upgrades, provenance/target fabrication, missing current facts, detached immutability, goal/graph comparison ordering, public-root runtime reachability, and accidental duplicated mapping. If review changes bytes, rerun the exact completion-evidence command. Before completion, inspect shared staging, unstage foreign entries only, and commit strictly by explicit owned pathspec; verify `git show --stat` and report any foreign whole-tree commit hazard rather than rewriting history.

comments.content: Active planning update after fresh code/design audit: current task is genuinely absent, but the exact `{currentAuthority, hold}` surface cannot compare `currentAuthority.goalVersion` to a hold fact because `ExpansionPlanningHoldState` and its reducer creation command contain no goalVersion. Existing `bindExpansionAdmission` compares that fifth value to `preparation.bound.goalVersion`. I am resolving this without inventing authority: the standalone binder will validate/carry goalVersion into the core HOLD_BINDING, compare the four hold-backed fields, and admission will retain the goalVersion cross-check against preparation while composing the sole binder. This preserves all five load-bearing comparisons and existing precedence. Root paths also collide with active task-5fa25bb..., so the plan will require sequence/re-measure before editing.
